extra_snippets: By Amit Chowdhry • Jan 20, 2026 · Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO ·

Alongside the transaction close, NetBrain announced a CEO transition and several board changes. Bernadette Nixon has been appointed chief executive officer and will join the company’s board. Founder Lingping Gao will step down as CEO and become chair of the board after leading the company for roughly two decades.

NetBrain positions its platform as a shift from reactive network visibility to proactive observability, using a digital twin and intent-based automation to help IT teams automate troubleshooting and change management. The company said it is used by more than one-third of the Fortune 500 and is headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, with additional locations in Munich, Toronto, Hyderabad, and Beijing. Nixon most recently served as CEO of Algolia, where she led scaling and global expansion, and previously was CEO of Alfresco, with earlier senior roles at SDL, OpenText, and CA, among others.
NetBrain also named Gus Malezis, an executive strategic advisor and chairman of IRIS Software Group, and Jerry Guo, founder, former CEO and chairman of Casa Systems, to its board of directors.
